_comment: One-way ceiling on TypeScript escape hatches per package. check-any-ratchet.ts fails when a count RISES. Lowering is free — after removing `any`s run `pnpm lint:any-ratchet --update` to lock the win. Raising requires editing this file in the same PR, which is the point: it turns silent type erosion into a reviewable diff. See the header of check-any-ratchet.ts for why this is a ratchet and not an ESLint rule.
